title: Phase 2 Speed Push: 18+ tok/s Single-Token & Q4_0 Speculative Engine
description: Squeeze the remaining latency out of the 84.3 ms/token (11.85 tok/s) Gemma-4 26B MoE decode step via 4-row AVX-512 register blocking, precomputed RoPE + 8-core GQA parallel attention, hybrid CPU+iGPU Q4 logit projection, dynamic QKV/MoE CPU+iGPU work-stealing, and Q4_0 quantized MTP draft speculation. Strictly follow TDD -> Impl -> Adversarial Review -> Fix -> Benchmark -> Commit (or discard if perf does not improve) for each bead.

title: Implement native Q4_0 2D LDS-tiled AMDGCN shader (q4_matmul_lds.ll -> .hsaco) with configurable out_stride
description: Port scratch/q8_matmul_lds.ll ([16 tokens x 16 rows] LDS cooperative tiling on gfx90c) to native Q4_0 weights (16 packed nibble bytes + fp32 scale per 32 weights). Eliminates 1.5 GB Q4->Q8 startup expansion buffer and halves GPU weight memory traffic.

title: Extract modular kfd_gpu.mojo runtime with dynamic ELF64 .hsaco segment & symbol loader
description: Deduplicate the 650-line GPUContext across model_q8_gpu.mojo, model_diffusion.mojo, and test_kernels.mojo into kfd_gpu.mojo. Parse Elf64_Ehdr, PT_LOAD phdrs, and .symtab/.strtab to map segments and resolve <kernel>.kd and group_segment_fixed_size dynamically instead of hardcoded 0x0/0x1b00/0x3200 and +0xa80.

title: Fix --no-mtp 4.5GB unused assistant_weights allocation, readline/EOF crash, and prefill/decode timing in gemma4_chat
description: When --no-mtp is passed, model_speculative_moe_batched.mojo still allocates and reads 4.5 GB of Float32 assistant_weights.bin, causing ~19.8 GB RAM pressure. Also wrap input() in try/except with readline support and separate prefill vs decode tok/s.
close_reason: Skipped 4.5GB MTP allocation on --no-mtp, added readline + try/except on input(), and separated Decode vs Prefill tok/s

title: Rework bare-metal AMD KFD GPU stack and integrate into Gemma-4 MoE + LSA
description: Modularize /dev/kfd + AQL userspace queue runtime, add dynamic ELF64 .hsaco loader, write native Q4_0 LDS-tiled GCN shader, fix AQL barrier serialization and cache invalidation bugs, and integrate with Gemma-4 26B MoE + LSA.

title: Q4_0 Quantized MTP Speculative Draft Model + Fast Argmax Head
description: Fix the 450 ms FP32 MTP draft bottleneck by quantizing the 4-layer MTP assistant weights (4.5 GB FP32 -> ~560 MB Q4_0) at load time (or caching assistant_weights_q4.bin), replacing mtp_gemv with fast Q4_0 matmuls, and replacing project_full_logits with Q4Embedding.project_logits_parallel. Write TDD test_mtp_q4_draft.mojo and benchmark end-to-end speculative decoding vs --no-mtp.

title: Hybrid CPU + KFD iGPU Co-Processed Final Logit Projection (262,144 Vocab)
description: Eliminate the 15.8 ms CPU-only logit bottleneck by mapping Q4Embedding (440 MB) into zero-copy KFD GTT memory (or registering its aligned pages) and dispatching the first N_gpu vocab rows to the KFD iGPU (q4_matmul_lds.hsaco) concurrently while the 8 CPU cores evaluate the remaining 262144 - N_gpu rows with 4-row register blocking + monotonic tanh hoisting. Write TDD test_hybrid_gpu_logits.mojo and benchmark.

title: Dynamic QKV Split-Wq & Zero-Copy iGPU MoE Expert Work-Stealing
description: Fix the 8:1 Global QKV imbalance, 2:1 SWA QKV imbalance, and 60% iGPU idle time during MoE by: (1) offloading a slice of Wq to iGPU in the same barrier-free AQL burst as Wk+Wv, and (2) flushing all 14.26 GB of MoE expert weights once at startup so the iGPU can execute active MoE expert(s) concurrently alongside the 8 CPU cores. Write TDD test_igpu_moe_worksteal.mojo and benchmark.

title: 4-Row AVX-512 Register Tiling & Zero-Alloc q4_matmul_vec + MoE Kernels
description: Eliminate the 90 per-token heap allocations (alloc/free of x_deint) inside q4_matmul_vec and upgrade q4_matmul_vec, run_moe_experts_stage1_8core, and run_moe_experts_stage2_8core from 2-row to 4-row register blocking (acc0..acc3) so x_even and x_odd are loaded from L1 half as often. Write TDD test_q4_4row_tiling.mojo, benchmark vs 2-row baseline, and keep/commit only if faster.

title: 1960s Trig Table Lookup RoPE & 8-Core GQA Group-Parallel Attention
description: Replace the 138,240 scalar pow/cos/sin calls per token in apply_rope with a precomputed inverse-frequency table + once-per-layer SIMD cos/sin evaluation, and parallelize paged_attention_layer (across 8 KV groups on SWA layers and 16 query heads on Global layers) and lsa_sparse_paged_attention across all CPU cores. Write TDD test_rope_and_parallel_attn.mojo, verify bit-exact/1e-6 accuracy, and benchmark.

title: Batched Speculative Draft Verification (batch=5 GEMM) + Hoare Bucket-Sorted MoE Expert Coalescing
description: Replace sequential 5x batch=1 verification in MTP speculative decoding with a single batched (batch=num_steps+1) layer-first target pass using 2D LDS-tiled q4_matmul_lds.hsaco on iGPU + bucket-sorted MoE expert coalescing on CPU (so shared experts across the 5 draft tokens are loaded from RAM only once). TDD + benchmark.
close_reason: Implemented Hoare (1961) Bucket-Sorted Multi-Token MoE Expert Coalescing (run_moe_coalesced_subbatch), double-buffered LSALayerIndex staging keys with rollback_to across 512-token Ward cluster boundaries, and single-pass batch=5 speculative draft verification. Verified 2.20x MoE coalescing speedup and 2.38e-7 max error in test_spec_verify_and_coalesce.mojo; prefill jumped to 24.95 tok/s (lossless) and 29.17 tok/s (with --moe-top-p 0.85, 12.06 tok/s decode).

title: Monotonic tanh Hoisting + Early-Z Prefix Culling (PVS) for 262k Vocab Logit Head in q4_embed.mojo
description: 1) Hoist monotonic 30*tanh(sum/30) out of the 262,144-row inner loop in Q4Embedding.project_logits_parallel (zero accuracy loss, eliminates 262k tanh calls/token). 2) Implement 2-stage Coarse-to-Fine / Early-Z prefix block culling (evaluating high-energy prefix blocks + hot token working set first and pruning dominated vocab rows before reading the remaining 75% of cache lines). Verify 100% top-1 token identity with TDD and benchmark latency.
close_reason: Implemented Dual-Space Loop-Invariant Nibble Deinterleaving (x_even/x_odd SIMD[float32, 16]), Exact Euclidean Tail L2 Norm Early-Z PVS, and Monotonic tanh Hoisting in q4_embed.mojo and q4_matmul_vec; verified 60/60 (100%) recall in test_q4_embed_pvs.mojo (1.48x speedup) and boosted Gemma-4 26B decode speed from 8.27 tok/s to 8.81 tok/s (16.6 tok/s prefill).

title: GameDev Hierarchical LOD / Russian-Roulette Top-p Expert Pruning for MoE Routing
description: Implement cumulative probability mass cutoff (--moe-top-p, e.g. 0.90) in MoE routing (Clark 1976 LOD / Arvo & Kirk 1990 Russian Roulette): since top-8 experts are sorted by router probability, prune low-weight tail experts once cumulative probability exceeds threshold and renormalize retained expert weights to preserve energy. TDD + benchmark tok/s vs quality.
close_reason: Implemented Clark (1976) Hierarchical LOD / Arvo & Kirk (1990) Russian-Roulette Top-p MoE expert pruning (--moe-top-p) with energy-preserving renormalization and 8-core row-sliced coalesced Stage 1 / Stage 2 MoE execution. Verified 0.0 error and 1.73x MoE speedup in test_moe_lod_top_p.mojo; end-to-end Gemma-4 26B decode reached 11.75 tok/s and prefill reached 21.73 tok/s with identical 49-token output.

title: CDC-6600 Asymmetric Co-Processor Overlap in Decode (wq/wk/wv + wo + Shared MLP on KFD iGPU overlapped with CPU)
description: In single-token decode (batch=1), overlap iGPU wq (2816->8192, 12.4 MB) with CPU wk+wv (2816->2048, 6.2 MB), run wo (8192->2816, 12.4 MB) on KFD iGPU (3.5x faster than CPU), and overlap Shared MLP (w_gate + w_up) with CPU MoE Router + Experts. Verify bit/token accuracy with TDD and benchmark tok/s.

title: Break the LLM Inference Memory Wall using 1960s/70s CS & GameDev Algorithms
description: Apply classic 1960s/70s systems/numerical algorithms and 1990s GameDev culling/LOD techniques to slash DRAM bandwidth and boost GPU/CPU compute utilization in Gemma-4 26B MoE.

title: Integrate kfd_gpu + q4_matmul_lds into model_speculative_moe_batched.mojo for batched prefill and hybrid CPU+iGPU execution
description: Replace sequential token-by-token CPU prefill in model_speculative_moe_batched.mojo with batched KFD Q4 GEMM dispatches for Wq/Wk/Wv/Wo and Shared MLP, and overlap iGPU shared MLP / projections with CPU MoE expert evaluation during decode.

title: Add multi-packet AQL barrier-free dispatch batching and fix temp_packed cache invalidation bug
description: Allow enqueueing independent kernels (e.g. Wq, Wk, Wv or w_gate, w_up) with barrier=False and a single doorbell ring. Fix model_diffusion.mojo bug where temp_packed_q/k/v were read by CPU without clflush invalidation while canvas_q/k/v were flushed after CPU writes.

title: Offload LSA 512-token block PCA projection and [512, 512] cosine Gram matrix to KFD iGPU
description: When an LSALayerIndex block reaches 512 keys, offload the [512, 768] @ [768, 64]^T projection, L2 normalization, and [512, 512] Gram matrix to KFD before CPU mutual-cheapest Ward merging.
